notes: No sitemap: robots.txt is only 'User-agent: *' with no rules and no Sitemap line, crawl_delay is 1.0, and /sitemap.xml returned no URLs. Use crawl_delay 1.0. The site runs on WordPress with what looks like the Property Hive plugin. The index /find-a-property/ shows mixed results by default (39 properties, the first page was all lettings); adding the query param department=residential-sales gave 16 sales listings. Lettings and sales share the /property/<slug>/ URL shape, so the pattern alone cannot tell them apart. Only follow /property/ links from the sales-filtered index, and also reject a page if its status label (just after the menu) is 'To Let', 'Let', or 'Let Agreed', or if its price contains 'pcm'. Sales labels seen: 'For Sale' and 'Sold STC' (decide downstream whether to keep Sold STC). Pagination is by path: /find-a-property/page/N/?department=residential-sales. Quirk: page 1 said 'Showing 1–12 of 16' but showed all 16 cards; page 2 said 'Showing 13–16 of 16' but rendered no cards ('It seems we can't find what you're looking for'). Stop paging when a page has no /property/ links, and deduplicate URLs. Host is www.jaksandco.co.uk (the homepage links use www); some slugs end in -2, so don't assume slugs are unique per address. A 'Commercial' tab exists in the search form; it was not explored, but the sales filter appears to exclude it. Listing pages are fully server-rendered. Brochure PDFs are linked at /wp-content/uploads/*.pdf. Tenure and property type were not confirmed on listing pages because the fetch output was truncated.
